entities.name: RlmN
observations: 351-aa query matches reviewed bacterial RlmN homologs at 49.0–55.5% identity and 96.0–96.6% query coverage.
Homolog annotations describe methylation of 23S rRNA A2503 and tRNA A37; exact substrates for this query are inferred from homology.
Query has Pfam RlmN_N domain (residues 5–62) and Radical_SAM domain (107–274), consistent with radical-SAM enzyme family.
Homolog annotations place RlmN in the cytoplasm; localization for this query is inferred, not directly measured.

entities.name: RNA methylation
observations: RlmN homolog annotations associate this protein family with 23S rRNA base methylation and tRNA methylation.
